title:
Перевод с русского
съедает секунды
body: Пока мозг собирает идеальную грамматику, собеседник уже ждёт реакцию.
prompt:
[CRITICAL INSTRUCTION - TEXT SAFE ZONES] 1080x1350 vertical Instagram carousel poster. Keep all readable text inside a 76px left/right safe zone and 76px top/bottom safe zone. Text must be horizontal, crisp, and readable.

[STYLE MODE] Emergence. Palette: aurora-lime-cobalt; background #081018/#101a2b; accent #d9f056, #22d3ee, #7c3aed. Do not copy a black-white-red reference literally; use this palette.

[TYPOGRAPHY] Condensed heavy poster typography, bold editorial hierarchy, high contrast, no tiny decorative labels except one short category label.

[HERO VISUAL] Large premium pseudo-3D clock object, glossy material, cinematic shadows, positioned so it does not cover headline.

[SLIDE CONTENT] Title: "Перевод с русского съедает секунды" Body: "Пока мозг собирает идеальную грамматику, собеседник уже ждёт реакцию."

[BRAND RULE] Product name is exactly Phraseman. No logo needed. No slide counters. No footer slogans.

[OUTPUT] Slide 3 of a cohesive carousel, poster-quality, suitable for Russian-speaking English learners.
